semantic_authority: Project 03 — A PRASA Business, Brand & Administration
target_variant: European Portuguese appropriate to Cabo Verde
intent: Supplies the approved English and Portuguese starter messages prefilled into the WhatsApp composer when a visitor selects one of the four governed quick actions and then activates the panel's Open WhatsApp action. One row per quick action; there is deliberately no fifth generic message, because a visitor who selects nothing keeps the incumbent short-link destination. The messages name aprasa.org as the source channel, and that visible text is the whole of the attribution: no hidden text and no tracking parameter is added. Injected at runtime, so the values reach the page through the governed i18n-strings block. Strictly additive.

rows.pt: Olá, encontrei A PRASA através de aprasa.org e gostaria de partilhar um evento ou uma oportunidade.
rows.context_notes: Starter message prefilled into the WhatsApp composer for the matching governed quick action.
rows.linguistic_notes: Project 09 identity policy as supplied: TRANSLATE — preserve A PRASA. The protected brand string and the aprasa.org source channel are carried verbatim into Portuguese.
